subject: Request: temporary availability exemption & reduced service-credit cap for TradeWinds POC
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@tradewinds.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tradewinds.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TradeWinds POC - request for temporary availability exception during migration window

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team at TradeWinds is excited to move the POC to a production-like migration next month. One thing that came up in our internal procurement review: the planned migration is expected to incur some short-term capacity impacts as we sync large volumes of historical data and run stress tests.

We need to request a temporary deviation from the standard availability target during the migration window (21 days). Specifically:
- Requested temporary availability target: 99.8% (normal: 99.95%) for the 21-day migration window starting July 12.
- Request that service-credit exposure for any incident during that window be capped at $10,000 total.
- In return, TradeWinds is willing to commit to a 12-month contract (start-of-billing at the end of POC) and provide shared telemetry during the migration.

Attached: POC_Traffic_Report_May2026.xlsx (traffic profile + estimated peak token volumes).

Can you escalate this to your team for an executive exception? Procurement has asked for written confirmation of the temporary clause and any one-time onboarding credit you can offer to offset migration risk.

Best,
Maria Ortega
Head of Platform Operations
TradeWinds AI


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: TradeWinds POC - request for temporary availability exception during migration window

Team — forwarding request from TradeWinds (see below). Quick summary and my recommendation:

Ask from customer:
- Temporary availability target of 99.8% for a 21-day migration (starting ~2026-07-12)
- Cap service-credit exposure during that window to $10k
- Request for a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration risk

Why I recommend we approve (commercial):
- TradeWinds is prepared to sign 12-month committed usage post-POC; strong strategic prospect in fintech analytics.
- The migration traffic profile is short-lived and constrained to a known window.
- Approving with tight contractual guardrails reduces churn risk and accelerates deal close.

My proposed concession (subject to legal):
- Grant a 21-day temporary availability tolerance: 99.8%
- Cap total service-credit exposure during that window at $10,000
- Provide a one-time onboarding credit of $15,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Require telemetry ingestion, migration schedule, and weekly checkpoint calls as preconditions

Please see attached mutual action plan (TradeWinds_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.docx) — includes proposed dates.

Ask: Grace, can legal draft a narrow temporary-exemption clause and confirm this language limits downstream SLA exposure? Dylan — this will require exec approval due to the $15k credit + non-standard SLA term. If we get signoff, I’ll push the revised contract to DocuSign and coordinate with CS for telemetry onboarding.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference


From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: TradeWinds POC - request for temporary availability exception during migration window

Ben / team,

Thanks — reviewed the commercial ask and pulled a draft redline for a temporary availability carve-out. High level comments:

- We can support a time-limited availability tolerance, but it must be tightly scoped. Proposed changes:
  * Explicit start and end dates for the exemption (no open-ended language).
  * Obligation for the customer to provide migration schedule and to onboard telemetry with read-only access for our SREs.
  * Limit remedies to a single, defined credit (one-time) during the exemption window. Avoid open percentage-based credits that could compound with other incidents.
  * Add a clause that automatically reverts the SLA to standard terms at the end of the window.

- Financial approvals: below $10k in cap we can handle (Commercial), but the proposed $15k onboarding credit exceeds standard delegated authority — need Dylan or VP signoff for anything over $10k in one-time concessions.

I attached a short text file with a candidate SLA carve-out to include in the contract (redline_sla_clause.txt). If the execs approve the commercial parameters Ben suggested (15k credit + 10k cap), I’ll convert the redline to a DocuSign-ready amendment and include the telemetry/acceptance language.

Legal note — keep the exemption narrowly drawn around the migration activities described; do not change underlying uptime measurement method or rolling windows outside the defined period.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel, Contracting & Commercial
Redwood Inference


From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@tradewinds.ai>, procurement@tradewinds.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: TradeWinds POC - request for temporary availability exception during migration window

Ben / team / TradeWinds — I reviewed the ask and Grace's proposed redline. I'm prepared to approve the temporary deviation with the following conditions:

1) Temporary availability tolerance set to 99.8% for the fixed period of 2026-07-12 through 2026-08-01 (inclusive).
2) Total service-credit exposure for incidents occurring during that period capped at $10,000.
3) One-time onboarding credit of $15,000 applied to the first invoice as a commercial concession.
4) TradeWinds must provide a migration schedule and grant read-only telemetry access for our SREs at least 5 business days before the start date.
5) Legal to finalize the narrow carve-out language; it must explicitly revert SLA/credit terms to standard contract language at 2026-08-02.

Ben: you have executive clearance to proceed on this basis. Grace: please prepare the DocuSign amendment and run the final contract with the customer. Tessa/CS: coordinate telemetry onboarding and the weekly checkpoint cadence.

Maria / TradeWinds: if you confirm acceptance of the conditions above, we will issue the amendment and DocuSign link today.

—Dylan Brooks
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
